assumptions: Jacobian is sampled at host command time; RTDE target/actual velocities are sampled at the first frame echoing that exact command sequence.
RTDE actual_TCP_speed is compared as recorded; the Jacobian comparison localizes telemetry relationships and is not a controller acceptance gate.
This diagnostic does not establish why command and physical velocity differ.

join.association: first RTDE frame with exact consumed_packet_sequence and receive time >= command publish time - 1 ms

force_preemptive_rnn_warm_start.purpose: remove strict-RNN state lag at each rising-load episode without raising the raw guard

force_rise_inward_cap.purpose: limit additional inward baseline realization during a sharp measured force rise before the main preempt threshold

delay T from actual dt

interpretation: Replays the recorded QP Jacobian, twist, solver bounds, and post-solve slew bound using the exact library SHA in the live dispatch receipt.
Replaying the host slew after the QP solve is a frozen-input command reconstruction; it is not a counterfactual closed-loop path or force score.
The recorded actual_qd gate failure remains unchanged; no result here promotes the attempt or changes its denominator.

latest_readonly_preflight.command_scope: read-only Dashboard, RTDE output and TCP connect-only; no motion, program, sensor, zero, TCP or payload writes

method: exact consumed_packet_sequence join; no packet shifting

current_builder_descriptor.claim: compiled solver only; no realtime or physical qualification

objective_interpretation.problem: min 0.5*||qdot||^2 subject to J*qdot=twist and joint-velocity box bounds
objective_interpretation.solver_warm_start: previous OSQP x/y numerical state only; it is not an objective continuity penalty

post_solver_slew_association.implementation: TaseContactProvider applies same-direction qdot rescale against previous published qdot after solver output
